# Chiefly

> Chiefly is a personal AI chief of staff. A private AI that runs on your computer: local by default, cloud opt-in. A no-subscription AI assistant. You pay once, and your Chiefly keeps working, even if we don’t. Updates may stop; your copy keeps working.

It runs on your computer. It asks before it acts.

The waitlist is open. Friend tests come first. Join the waitlist to hear when early access opens.

Chiefly asks before it acts. Nothing happens until you say so.

Launch prices won’t go back down. Early access is Regular $199, and Student $69, which covers 4 years or until graduation. At launch it is Regular $299, and Student $99. A no-subscription AI assistant. You pay once. Early access isn’t open yet. Join the waitlist to get founder’s pricing.

Student one-time AI: one payment covers four years, or until graduation.

## Principles

- You own it. You don’t rent it.
- Local by default. Cloud only if you opt in.
- Your Chiefly keeps working, even if we don’t. Updates may stop; your copy keeps working.
- It works for you, and only you.
- See and delete what it remembers, anytime.

## Names

- Company: Chiefly
- Product: Chiefly
- Codename: Jarvis
- Site: https://chieflyos.com/

Codename Jarvis grew up. Chiefly is the product, and you own it.
